svg.title: Counter S06 saved VCD and independent expected samples
svg.text: Generic node-netlist simulation; zero delay; no PDK/SDF
Green dots: independent expected samples match observed VCD (42/42). Orange dashes: t = 26 + 50 x cycle ns.
Original contract: 14 cycles, 50 ns period; reset at cycles 0 and 9; compare 1 ns after each rising edge.
This plot re-reads retained transitions; it is not a new simulator run or dynamic SDF timing qualification.
